```{r, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  results='asis', 
  echo = FALSE
)
library(tidyverse)
library(glue)



# Set this to true to have links turned into footnotes at the end of the document
PDF_EXPORT <- FALSE

# Holds all the links that were inserted for placement at the end
links <- c()

source('parsing_functions.R')


# First let's get the data, filtering to only the items tagged as
# Resume items
# Data prep (replace your old position_data block with this)
position_raw <- readr::read_csv("positions.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

position_data <- position_raw %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    # normalize section labels
    section0     = stringr::str_to_lower(stringr::str_trim(section)),
    section_norm = stringr::str_replace_all(section0, "[^a-z0-9]+", "_"),

    # coerce in_resume to logical
    in_resume = dplyr::case_when(
      is.logical(in_resume)   ~ in_resume,
      is.numeric(in_resume)   ~ in_resume == 1,
      is.character(in_resume) ~ tolower(trimws(in_resume)) %in% c("true","t","yes","y","1"),
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    ),

    # collapse to buckets your Rmd expects
    section = dplyr::case_when(
      section_norm %in% c("research_positions","industry_positions") ~ "positions",
      section_norm %in% c(
        "writings","writing","data_science_writings","by_me_press",
        "academic_articles","academic_article","academic_writings",
        "publications","articles","blog_posts"
      ) ~ "writings",
      TRUE ~ section_norm
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(in_resume)

```
